Initial release with LMNP micro-BIC vs. régime réel comparison and Vestafolio simulator workflow.

- Compares the two main tax regimes for non-professional furnished rentals (LMNP) in France: micro-BIC and régime réel with amortization.
- Guides users through all required questions before running personalized simulations, using the Vestafolio simulator API for accurate calculations.
- Delivers clear recommendations, annual and 10-year savings, and an amortization schedule, based strictly on simulator outputs.
- Automatically responds in French if the user asks in French.
- Explains applicable rules (abattements, thresholds, amortization, etc.) as implemented in the simulator.
- Provides a link to the interactive simulator for further exploration.
